rune.elementalcircuits.filter.descriptio: Route selected elements and polarities through a dedicated output.
rune.elementalcircuits.material_filter.d: Filter container input and recovered drops by item ID or tag.
rune.elementalcircuits.throttle.descript: Limit mana per logic tick; route accepted mana and excess separately.
rune.elementalcircuits.edge.description: Turn a rising edge, falling edge, or any signal change into a one-tick pulse.
rune.elementalcircuits.select.descriptio: Route input to different outputs according to signal level.
rune.elementalcircuits.delay.description: Delay signal changes while preserving pulse order and duration.
rune.elementalcircuits.anchor.descriptio: Fix a world-space reference point for a contact link.
rune.elementalcircuits.target.descriptio: Restrict the types of targets eligible for a contact link.
rune.elementalcircuits.probe.description: Read nearby targets or link state without changing the world.
rune.elementalcircuits.angle.description: Set the full spread angle of a fan-shaped spell.
rune.elementalcircuits.yaw.description: Set horizontal offset from the aimed direction.
rune.elementalcircuits.pitch.description: Raise or lower the spell relative to the aimed direction.
rune.elementalcircuits.distance.descript: Set the reference distance for a constrained link.
rune.elementalcircuits.contact.descripti: Lock onto an aimed target and maintain a contact link.
rune.elementalcircuits.force.description: Apply continuous force along the selected direction.
rune.elementalcircuits.constraint.descri: Hold the target near a reference position.
rune.elementalcircuits.interact.descript: Activate a linked block when its signal is triggered.

rune.elementalcircuits.item_output.descr: Send dismantled drops to an adjacent fixed-circuit container.
rune.elementalcircuits.redstone.descript: Sample nearby redstone strength and emit a control signal.
rune.elementalcircuits.storage.descripti: Accumulate injected mana and release it by threshold and amount.
rune.elementalcircuits.input.description: Draw a configured amount of mana from the wielder.
rune.elementalcircuits.absorb.descriptio: Draw pure mana from the local mana field.
rune.elementalcircuits.output.descriptio: Resolve and release the configured spell.
rune.elementalcircuits.and.description: Wait for every input; combine signals with AND logic.
rune.elementalcircuits.or.description: Accept any available input; combine signals with OR logic.
rune.elementalcircuits.not.description: Invert elemental polarity or signal state.
rune.elementalcircuits.switch.descriptio: Open or close a route manually or through a signal.
rune.elementalcircuits.sensor.descriptio: Activate at its upper threshold and reset below its lower threshold.
rune.elementalcircuits.split.description: Distribute mana across outgoing routes by configured weights.
rune.elementalcircuits.merge.description: Merge mana arriving from multiple routes.
rune.elementalcircuits.area.description: Cast around the circuit or the wielder.
rune.elementalcircuits.sphere.descriptio: Create a spherical effect or projectile.
rune.elementalcircuits.beam.description: Fire a beam in a straight line.
rune.elementalcircuits.shield.descriptio: Create a barrier with limited capacity and duration.
rune.elementalcircuits.fan.description: Release a forward fan shaped by the angle rune.
rune.elementalcircuits.wall.description: Create a vertical elemental wall at the target position.
rune.elementalcircuits.ring.description: Create a ring-shaped effect with an empty center.
rune.elementalcircuits.cross.description: Release elements along four cardinal directions.
rune.elementalcircuits.amount.descriptio: Set the target effect strength for one cast.
rune.elementalcircuits.counter.descripti: Count signal events and emit a pulse at the configured count.
rune.elementalcircuits.clock.description: Emit a pulse at the configured interval.
rune.elementalcircuits.toggle.descriptio: Toggle its latched state on each signal event.
rune.elementalcircuits.burst.description: Release a spherical secondary effect on impact.
rune.elementalcircuits.bounce.descriptio: Reflect a projectile the configured number of times.
rune.elementalcircuits.homing.descriptio: Track a visible target ahead of the projectile.
rune.elementalcircuits.fragment.descript: Split on impact into several projectiles sharing mana.
rune.elementalcircuits.chain.description: Jump from a hit target to nearby targets.
rune.elementalcircuits.ignite.descriptio: Apply a burning effect to the target.
rune.elementalcircuits.slow.description: Apply a slowing effect to the target.
rune.elementalcircuits.convert.descripti: Convert pure mana into the selected element.
rune.elementalcircuits.mana_send.descrip: Send mana and its modifiers to a connected circuit.
rune.elementalcircuits.signal_receive.de: Receive a signal published by a linked circuit.
rune.elementalcircuits.signal_send.descr: Publish an internal signal to connected routes.
